title: Architectural Design
description: Concept-led architecture that answers to site, climate and the way you live or work — from first massing study to a resolved building.
detailedDescription:
Every building starts with listening. We study the site's light, wind, views and context, then develop a concept that turns your brief into a clear architectural idea.

From there we refine plans, sections and elevations in close dialogue with you, testing each decision in drawings and models until the design is resolved, buildable and unmistakably yours.

title: Building Design
description: Complete design for your house or building — plans, elevations and 3D views that make the most of your plot and budget.
detailedDescription:
Building design starts with your plot, your family or business and your budget. We study the site, local bye-laws and orientation, then plan rooms, circulation, light and ventilation so the building works well every day.

You see the design in clear 2D plans and 3D views before construction, and we refine it with you until it is right.

title: Structural Design
description: Safe, economical structural design — foundations, columns, beams and slabs — coordinated with the architecture and ready to build.
detailedDescription:
Working with licensed structural engineers, we prepare foundation, column, beam and slab drawings fully coordinated with the architecture.

Clear dimensions, schedules and reinforcement details mean fewer site queries and a structure that does exactly what the design intends.

title: Interior Design
description: Interiors composed as architecture — proportion, light, material and detail working together as one calm, considered whole.
detailedDescription:
We design interiors from the inside out: how a room is entered, where light falls through the day, what the hand touches. Joinery, lighting and finishes are drawn as part of the architecture, never applied afterwards.

The result is a space with a quiet, lasting character — one that feels resolved on day one and better ten years on.
pricing: Fixed fee or per sq. ft

title: Residential Architecture
description: Private homes, villas and farmhouses designed around family life — generous, climate-aware and made to last generations.
detailedDescription:
A home is the most personal brief there is. We spend time understanding rituals — mornings, gatherings, solitude — and plan spaces that hold them gracefully.

Courtyards, shaded verandahs, cross-ventilation and natural materials are recurring tools in our residential work, balancing modern living with the climate of the Indian subcontinent.

title: Commercial Architecture
description: Workplaces, retail and hospitality buildings that express a brand clearly and perform efficiently for the people using them.
detailedDescription:
Commercial buildings must work hard: for occupants, operators and the balance sheet. We design for flexible floor plates, efficient structure and services, and a clear public identity at street level.

We coordinate closely with consultants and developers to keep programme, compliance and budget aligned from day one.

title: 2D Planning & 3D Visualization
description: Clear 2D plans and photoreal 3D renders and walkthroughs, so you can see — and decide — before anything is built.
detailedDescription:
Good decisions need good pictures. We produce measured 2D plans alongside photoreal stills, aerial views and walkthrough films of your project.

Visualisation is part of how we design, not just how we present: options are tested in 3D so material, light and proportion are agreed with confidence.

title: Renovation & Remodeling
description: Giving existing buildings a second life — reworking plans, light and services while respecting what makes them special.
detailedDescription:
Many of our favourite projects begin with an existing building. We survey carefully, keep what has character and rethink what no longer works — opening plans, bringing in light, upgrading structure and services.

Phasing and site management are planned so renovation is as calm as possible for those still living or working there.

title: Space Planning
description: Making every square foot count — layouts that flow, store well and adapt as needs change.
detailedDescription:
Space planning is where comfort is won or lost. We map how people move and use each area, then test layouts that improve flow, storage, privacy and natural light.

For workplaces, we plan for growth and flexibility; for homes, for the stages of family life.

title: Architectural Consultancy
description: Independent advice before you buy, build or invest — feasibility, design reviews and second opinions.
detailedDescription:
Not every client needs a full commission. We advise on land purchase, feasibility, bye-law potential, design reviews and value engineering.

A few focused hours of expert input at the right moment can save months and significant cost later.

title: Construction Documentation
description: Complete, coordinated working drawings and specifications — the instruction set your builder needs.
detailedDescription:
A beautiful design is only as good as the drawings that build it. We prepare comprehensive working drawings, details, door and window schedules, and specifications.

Every set is coordinated with structure and services so contractors can price accurately and build without guesswork.

title: Project Supervision
description: Regular site presence to make sure what's built matches what was designed — on quality, time and budget.
detailedDescription:
We stay with the project on site. Scheduled visits, quality checks, contractor coordination and clear reporting keep the build true to the design.

You receive concise progress updates with photos, so you always know where things stand.
